999008199.text:
お待たせしました！
必要そうな素材を集めてきました！

localizations.en: Sorry for the wait! I got all the materials I think we'll need!

999008199.text:
おお、レスナ殿に、皆様！
お久しぶりでございまする！

localizations.en: Oh! Resna, and everyone! It has been quite some time!

999008199.text:
鬼門！　久しぶり！
あれ、なんか結構人が集まってる？

localizations.en: Kimon! It's been a while! Wait, there are quite a few people here, aren't there?

999008199.text: 拙者、鏑矢様の計らいで休暇をいただいておりまする！

localizations.en: Lord Kaburaya was kind enough to grant me some time off!

999008199.text:
そんな折に、鬼門と再会できるとは。
ケイウン以来だな

localizations.en: Of all the times to run into you. It's been a while since Keiun.

999008199.text:
あたしとレイニャはさっきまで無数島群域を巡ってて、
帰ってきたところ！

localizations.en: Lenja and I were just out touring the Infinite Island Chain. We just got back!

999008199.text:
調査団への報告が終わって、
少し休んでいました

localizations.en: I finished filing my report to the research team and was taking a little break.

999008199.text: なるほどねー……む？　むむむ？

どうしたの、アルビーナ？　そんなに唸って。
もしかして、お腹痛い？

localizations.en: What's wrong, Alvina? You're making a weird face. Do you have a stomachache or something?

999008199.text:
違うわい！　いやなんかさ。
みんな頭に耳が生えてるなーって

localizations.en: I do not! It's just... everyone's got ears on top of their head.

999008199.text: 確かに……！

……ねえ、みんなにも参加してもらおうよ！　優勝を
狙うなら、可能性は少しでも高いほうがよくない？

localizations.en: ...Hey, why don't we get everyone to join in? If we're aiming for the win, having more chances can't hurt, right?

999008199.text: いったい、なんの話だ……？

なるほど、武道会でございまするか。
拙者、腕試しとまいりましょう！

localizations.en: A martial arts tournament, you say. Count me in—I could use a good test of my skills!

999008199.text:
悪くない。手ごわい相手と戦わないと
腕がなまると思っていたところだ。力を貸すぞ

localizations.en: Not a bad idea. I was just thinking my edge would dull without a proper challenge. I'm in.

999008199.text:
よく分かんないけど、やるやる！
なんだか面白そうだし！

localizations.en: I don't really know what's going on, but I'm totally doing it! Sounds like a blast!

999008199.text:
レイニャ……ダメダメだけど、
皆さんの役に立てるなら……頑張ります……！

localizations.en: Lenja's... not sure she can handle it, but... if it'll help everyone... she'll give it a shot...!

999008199.text: よっしゃ！　これで戦力２倍だね！

localizations.en: Yes! Now we've got twice the firepower!

999008199.text:
じゃあ、改めて詳細を確認しましょう。
会場となるのは、広大な砂漠です

localizations.en: Alright, let's go over the details again. The venue is a vast desert.

999008199.text:
そこに参加者が一斉に放り込まれて、最後まで倒れずに
残った者が勝利、という単純明快な戦いです

localizations.en: All participants are thrown in at once, and the last one standing wins. Simple as that.

999008199.text:
武器や道具の持ち込みは自由なんだよね。
アタシはもちろん、ハンマーを持っていくよ！

localizations.en: And we can bring in whatever weapons and gear we want, right? I'm obviously bringing my hammer!

999008199.text:
最後まで倒れず残った者が勝利とのことだが……
参加者同士で結託することは問題ないんだな？

localizations.en: Last one standing wins, you said... but teaming up with other participants is allowed?

999008199.text:
大丈夫そうですが……国王陛下の
「生き様を見せろ」という言葉が気になります

localizations.en: It seems so, but... I keep thinking about what the king said. About proving our mettle.

999008199.text:
知力や団結力もまた力っしょ！　……でもまぁ、
全員並んで仲良く優勝ってわけにはいかないかと

localizations.en: Strategy and teamwork are strengths too! ...That said, I doubt we can all line up and share the win.

999008199.text:
真剣勝負が求められているのだろう？
ならば、唯一の勝者は決めねばな

localizations.en: A true contest demands a single victor. If it comes down to it, we'll have to settle it properly.

999008199.text:
もし我々だけが残ったとしても、
最後は恨みっこなし、ということでございまするね

localizations.en: If only we remain in the end, then we simply agree—no hard feelings, whatever the outcome.

999008199.text:
ひぇ。皆さんと、戦う……？
やられたふりの練習をしておきます……

localizations.en: Eep. Fighting... each other...? Maybe she'll practice pretending to lose beforehand...

999008199.text:
まぁ、誰かが勝てばそれでヨシ！
目指せ、優勝ー！！！

localizations.en: Well, as long as someone from our group wins, it's all good! Let's go for it—first place!!!

999008199.text: おー！！！

ケイウン南部の領主に仕えている忍者。
「忍法」と呼ばれる様々な術を使う

localizations.en: A female ninja serving a lord in southern Keiun. She uses a variety of techniques known as ninjutsu.

999008199.text:
流浪の戦士。オーレン族「白牙氏族」の生き残り。
アンペルと共に各地を旅している

localizations.en: A wandering warrior. The last survivor of the Auren clan's White Fang tribe. She travels the world alongside Empel.

999008199.text:
人懐っこい性格の元気な冒険者。
謎の災害に見舞われた町「ハルフェン」出身

localizations.en: A friendly and energetic adventurer. She hails from Hallfein, a town that was struck by a mysterious disaster.

2072370017.text: リアス・アイトライゼ

999008199.text:
アラディス調査団所属、亜人種「ウェルクス」の少女。
小心者だが、高い身体能力を活かした戦闘が得意

localizations.en: A member of the Aladiss Research Team and a Welleks demihuman girl. Though timid, she excels in combat thanks to her exceptional physical abilities.
